question: As per 2011 Census, which of the following religions has the least population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jainism**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jainism had the smallest population of the major religions in India in 2011, according to the census data:
 
• Jainism is an ancient religion originating in India.
 
• It emphasizes non-violence (**ahimsa**), self-discipline, and the pursuit of spiritual liberation
